desc: Staged and ready from 2026-07-30: initramfs-dcuart-hidf.cpio.gz (e9fcd3b3, minimal busybox + the CJ-approved a1f4131d blob, nothing auto-opens inputs) + kernel carrying yuka d197cf69 (L2C_ERR fault address printed on SError). The HIDF upload fires on FIRST input-device open, which is why it killed graphical boots at ~1s. Boot this, reach the ttydc0 shell, then trigger deliberately with 'head -c1 /dev/input/event0' while the console captures. Goal: identify whether the crash is an SError (get the fault address) or something else. CJ granted the ticket-126 exception for a1f4131d only, volatile DMA, no flash. RESULT 2026-08-02: upload fires on first input open exactly as designed; MTP replies err 0xe00002c2 = kIOReturnBadArgument and the machine KEEPS RUNNING. The "HIDF crashes the boot" belief is REFUTED. magicmouse binds the device on event0 without firmware (motion untested - needs a human finger). Prime suspect: blob/SDK skew (MTP fw is SDK 25F63, our a1f4131d came from 25F84). Doc: done/2026-08-02-t6040-trackpad-HIDF-rejected-not-crash.md
author: claude
